entries.title: Isaiah 63:1
segments: Who [is] this who comes from Edom, [with] dyed garments from Bozrah, this One adorned in His clothing, bending down in His great power? I who speak in righteousness, great to save.

entries.title: Isaiah 63:2
segments: Why [is Your] clothing red, and Your garments like one who treads in the winepress?

entries.title: Isaiah 63:3
segments: I have trodden the winepress alone; and of the peoples [there was] no man with Me; for I will tread them in My anger and trample them in My fury; and their blood will be sprinkled on My garments, and I will stain all My clothing.

entries.title: Isaiah 63:4
segments: For the day of vengeance [is] in My heart, and the year of My redeemed has come.

entries.title: Isaiah 63:5
segments: And I looked, and [there was] none to help; and I wondered that there [was] no one to uphold; therefore My own arm has saved for Me; and My fury upheld Me.

entries.title: Isaiah 63:6
segments: And I will tread down the people in My anger, and make them drunk in My fury, and I will pour their juice to the earth.

entries.title: Isaiah 63:7
segments: I will mention the loving-kindnesses of the LORD, the praises of the LORD, according to all that the LORD has benefited for us, and the great good to the house of Israel [by] which He benefited them according to His mercies, and according to the multitude of His loving-kindnesses.

entries.title: Isaiah 63:8
segments: For He said, Surely they [are] My people, sons that will not lie; so He was their Savior.

entries.title: Isaiah 63:9
segments: In all their affliction He [was] afflicted, and the Angel of His presence saved them; in His love and in His pity He redeemed them; and He bore them, and carried them all the days of old.

entries.title: Isaiah 63:10
segments: But they rebelled, and troubled His Holy Spirit; therefore He was turned [to be] their enemy, [and] He fought against them.

entries.title: Isaiah 63:11
segments: Then He remembered the days of old, Moses [and] His people, [saying], Where [is] He who brought them up out of the sea with the shepherd of His flock? Where [is] He who put His Holy Spirit within him?

entries.title: Isaiah 63:12
segments: He led [them] by the right [hand] of Moses with His glorious arm, dividing the water before them, to make Himself an everlasting name?

entries.title: Isaiah 63:13
segments: He led them through the deep, like a horse in the wilderness, so that they would not stumble?

entries.title: Isaiah 63:14
segments: As a beast goes down into the valley, the Spirit of the LORD caused him to rest. So You led Your people, to make Yourself a glorious name.

entries.title: Isaiah 63:15
segments: Look down from Heaven, and look down from the place of Your holiness and of Your glory; where [is] Your zeal and Your strength, the multitude of Your tender affections and of Your mercies toward me? Are they withheld?

entries.title: Isaiah 63:16
segments: For You [are] our Father, though Abraham does not know us, and Israel does acknowledge us. You, O LORD, [are] our Father, our Redeemer; Your name is from everlasting.

entries.title: Isaiah 63:17
segments: O LORD, why have You made us wander from Your ways. You harden our heart from Your fear? For Your servants' sake, return the tribes of Your inheritance.

entries.title: Isaiah 63:18
segments: The people of Your holiness have possessed [it] but a little [while]; our enemies have trampled Your sanctuary.

entries.title: Isaiah 63:19
segments: We are from forever; You never ruled over them; Your name was never called on them.
